prompt:
Our OpenClaw AI assistant has been running for weeks and its local memory folder is a complete mess. Files are piling up across all the memory storage areas and nothing has been cleaned up in a long time. I need you to perform a full daily memory management cycle on the workspace at /workspace.

Specifically:
1. The storage tier configuration file has wrong values — please correct it so it matches our official memory manager settings.
2. Promote memory files that have aged past their tier's retention window into the next storage tier.
3. Enforce retention limits on learning round records and conversation logs — we have far too many and older ones need to go.
4. Make sure the main MEMORY.md index file is never touched or deleted.
5. When you're done, save a summary of everything that was migrated and deleted as memory-archive-report.json.

The SKILL.md file at /workspace/skills/memory-manager.js area and the broader OpenClaw documentation define the exact retention windows, limits, and configuration values that must be used.
